mechanism: Diltiazem enhances the antihypertensive and electrolyte-depleting effects of chlorthalidone, while thiazide diuretics may increase diltiazem levels; additive effects on cardiac conduction and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) increase arrhythmia risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess potassium and magnesium levels regularly, consider potassium-sparing agent or increased dietary potassium, and monitor for signs of bradycardia or AV block.
